title: Going through a list
instructions: for (int s : scores) { ... } runs the lines once for every box in the list. Each time round, s holds the next value.
This is the easiest way to look at everything in a list, one at a time.
total += s; is a short way to write total = total + s;
task: Add up every score, so the program prints:  Total: 15
hint:
Add each score into the total:

        total += s;
